<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that, in the forward direction, form a C‑C double bond (alkene) and an aliphatic carboxylic acid. These criteria match the Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons reaction and should return the appropriate template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds", "aliphatic carboxylic acid"]
}
</action_input>
